$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006). The `default` keywords here are exactly the constant defaults of 5.2's Separator table; the reference canonicalizer reads them as its table of constant defaults (9.2 step 1).
title: Separator
description: 5.2: a room separator — a boundary of zero thickness that divides rooms without building anything, an edge of its level's wall graph. Every separator MUST reference a level (FS-CORE-1.3.2). It has only the members of its table (FS-CORE-1.4.1).

level.description: 1.3, 5.2: a reference to the level the separator is on. Always present.

start.description: 5.2: a reference to the junction at one end. Always present.

end.description: 5.2: a reference to the junction at the other end. Always present.

arc.description: 21.1 (0.4): the circular arc the separator runs along. Absent: the separator is straight. No constant default.

option.description: 19.2: a reference to the option this separator is in. Absent: it is in no option, and so in every design.

name.description: 1.4: a human-readable label, 1–200 characters. Absent by default.
